scope: Browser-local populated settings presentation, including readable bilingual long values and light/dark original visual states.
Exercised display-name save/reload, forced failure preserving previous storage and draft, retry, rejected-submit field association/focus, newer draft during pending, and keyboard Save/Cancel.
limitations: The long navigation and larger fields require substantial compact-height/narrow scrolling to the save/status area.
Full sequential Tab traversal, email-change recovery and every field/toggle variation were not exercised; repeated behavior ran primarily in light English/reduced motion.
repair_disposition: No additional repair is required for this accepted scope: the demonstrated persistence, recovery and pending-draft distinction agree with the unchanged authoritative store. Compact-height refinement remains an improvement; untested flows are excluded rather than presumed correct.

scope: Local synthetic conversation, populated answer/composer layout and original light/dark/narrow visual states.

Exercised partial failure/retry to the long answer, wheel-selected reading continuity during streaming, Return to latest, stable Stop, six-line mixed draft/three local filenames and keyboard full-filename disclosure with Escape focus return.
limitations: The narrow horizontal attachment rail hides later files until lateral exploration; compact chips defer the filename-only boundary to details.

Normal-speed motion, software-keyboard occlusion, touch discovery and comprehensive message-edit/branch navigation remain unassessed. This is not acceptance of real model service, uploads or durable history.
repair_disposition: No additional repair is required for the accepted local workflow: the wheel, response-text, retry and focus observations resolve the consequential behavior uncertainties. Rail discoverability remains a documented presentation limitation; broader interaction/platform scope requires separate verification.

scope: Local editorial wiki reading/editing with retained long bilingual content and original light/dark/narrow pixels.

Exercised native English/Chinese edit confirmation, actual tiddler-file write and reload, confirmed discard, ledger navigation, search-result/editor keyboard entry, and contained narrow-table wheel inspection.
limitations: The narrow table initially clips columns with little visible scroll guidance and has no explicit region label/tabindex in inspected DOM. Keyboard horizontal table access is unresolved and excluded from acceptance.
Sticky titles consume reading space and can overlap the first visible text line during deep scrolling.
Server-outage recovery, broad assistive-technology use, full palette-selection journey and producer candidate-research process were not audited.
repair_disposition: No additional repair is required for the accepted reading/editing, persistence and pointer/wheel table scope: the full evidence-boundary column is reachable without panning the page and writes/reloads agree. Full keyboard-table acceptance remains unresolved; a named focusable containment treatment and direct keyboard verification should be considered before claiming that broader scope.

scope: The settled Tabler action-toast increment on the existing browser-local settings application.

Original light/dark, desktop/narrow meaningful-state pixels and exercised save/pending/error/invalid feedback, failed-snapshot retry while preserving a later draft, storage distinction, Cancel restore and explicit close/focus continuity.
limitations: The fixed toast obscures part of the upstream header/navigation until dismissed, especially narrow. This is a visible tradeoff of the settled placement.
Inherited single-line long profile fields remain cropped; a wider settings redesign is outside this bounded acceptance.
Dark transitions were judged from original pixels rather than every active transition; no natural-motion or assistive-technology certification.
repair_disposition: No additional repair is required for the accepted toast increment: keyboard retry persisted the failed snapshot, preserved later edits and returned sensible focus; close did not change storage. Header occlusion and inherited fields remain disclosed, not repaired or generalized into whole-settings acceptance.
